## async-context-carrier-lives-in-globalthis-symbol-slot  (rationale, verified)

## batching-sink-timer-due-mark-is-sticky  (rationale, verified)
The batching sink keeps a sticky #timerDue mark until its buffer empties, because re-arming the timer on settle would make overdue records wait a second full interval.

## breadcrumb-trail-belongs-to-the-nearest-child-of-root  (gotcha, verified)
A breadcrumb buffer starts at each child of the Scope root and is shared below it, so the default scope's trail is realm-wide and never cleared; tests asserting a trail must run inside Scope.isolated.
